02. Concurrency vs Parallelism

Concurrency means tasks overlap in progress; parallelism means tasks execute simultaneously on
multiple execution units.
Concurrency කියන්Jන් tasks කිහිපයක් අතර මාරැJවමින් වැඩ කිරීම. Parallelism කියන්Jන් cores
One core handles many I/O tasks; two cores compute two results simultaneously.

Q: Can a single-core CPU support concurrency?
A: Yes, through interleaving and waiting for I/O.
